# LiftOrbit

> Browser-based production planning and scheduling software for small and medium manufacturers.

## Official pages
- [LiftOrbit homepage](https://liftorbit.app/): product overview, capabilities, use cases, pricing preview and FAQ.
- [Production scheduling features](https://liftorbit.app/#features): Gantt chart, orders, machines, employees, materials, changeovers and schedule optimization.
- [How LiftOrbit works](https://liftorbit.app/#how-it-works): set up production resources, enter orders and constraints, generate and compare plans.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://liftorbit.app/#faq): setup, ERP compatibility, material planning, data policy and trial status.
- [LiftOrbit application](https://app.liftorbit.app/): account registration and product sign-in.

## Who it is for
Small and medium manufacturers, small-batch production teams and made-to-order workshops that need to schedule work across machines, people and material constraints.

## Current access status (2026-10-15)
The product has account registration. The advertised 30-day self-service trial activation and paid subscription billing are planned, not yet enabled. Pricing is not published. Avoid describing the trial or subscriptions as already active.

## Product capabilities
Visual production scheduling with a Gantt chart; order management; equipment and employee planning; material availability; changeover constraints; schedule optimization with comparisons and saved plans.

## Content language
English.
